items.item: User can pair a remote device with their host machine
Relayed traffic is unreadable to the edge
Remote access never grants more than local access
Stage gate: deleting the remote plane changes nothing locally

bugs.title: Email/search proposed from the phone is never shown on the host, though the phone says it must be approved on the computer
bugs.repro: Pair, tick folder, ask from phone 'search the web for cat videos' or 'send an email to sam@example.com ...'; look at host Work tab

bugs.title: Phone approval card is a run-on block, says buttons are above (they are below), Approve greyed with no reason
bugs.repro: Ask for an email from the phone

bugs.title: Voice from the phone ignores the selected folder and asks for a directory path
bugs.repro: Tick docs, select docs on phone, Start talking, say 'tell me about my files'

undesired.title: Host does not show a joined device until Check again is pressed; two Check again buttons in Settings; confusing 'Choose the device first.'
Phone does not update when a folder is ticked; no-folder ask says 'That folder is not available remotely.'
Folder tick prompt is far from the checkboxes; tiny 'Saved.' feedback
Start talking button says Stop talking even though host voice is switched off
Removed phone keeps a normal-looking screen with no 'removed, pair again' message
Phone relay prefilled as http:// while host uses ws://; long case-sensitive code, no copy button
Half-drafted email swallows the next request; tidy request returned a file list
Host voice greets automatically; greeting and nudge appear in the phone voice log (known)
